deadlineDiagnosis.contract: Each node must bootstrap within 15 minutes, measured from when a new node is required until it joins. Pod eviction has its own 15-minute timeout, followed by a 60-second post-eviction wait.

deadlineDiagnosis.finding: The nodegroup used one operation-created deadline for all replacement and scale-down work. The second replacement began after that deadline, but both actual new nodes joined Ready in approximately 7.5 minutes. The observed NodeCreationFailure therefore does not demonstrate a per-node bootstrap timeout. The earlier native panic and repair lengthened the operation but do not justify treating the complete rollout as one 15-minute bootstrap.
